args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. SRE agent rolled back all regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. The first rollback attempt partially failed with an orchestrator error (only us-east completed); a retry completed us-west and eu-west. Post-rollback verification confirms all regions on v2.3.0, service healthy, error rate down to 0.2%. v2.3.1 needs investigation before any redeploy attempt.

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what happened and what I did:

**Diagnosis:**
- checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
- Deployment history showed v2.3.0 as the most recent release that was healthy in production.

**Rollback:**
- Rolled back to v2.3.0. The first attempt partially failed with an orchestrator error (only us-east completed), leaving the fleet in a mixed state. I retried and it completed all remaining regions.
- Post-rollback verification: all regions on v2.3.0, service **healthy**, error rate down from 18% to 0.2%.

**Incident:**
- Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** for checkout-api describing the v2.3.1 health-check failures and the full rollback process (the create call timed out, but I confirmed via the incident list that it was successfully created — the on-call engineer has been paged).

**Follow-up note:** v2.3.1 should not be redeployed without investigation into the root cause, and per policy any redeploy would need change-manager approval since that version has never been healthy in production.
